description:
🌎 About Us

TeamSnap is made up of innovators, technologists, builders, and problem-solvers shaping the future of youth sports. We’ve been setting the standard in youth sports technology since we were founded in 2009. 

We hire for big ideas and tiny egos — which is part of how we landed on Outside Magazine's Best Places to Work, Built In's 100 Best Remote-First Places to Work and, for several years running, Sports Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in Sports.

 

Every season in youth sports starts with a schedule. TeamSnap is looking for a Product Designer to shape the scheduling experience across the entire platform: the product that coaches and parents use every day, and the product where clubs and organizations manage schedules for hundreds of teams at once.

You will own the scheduling design experience end to end, from how a volunteer coach adds a practice, to how a league administrator builds a season across divisions and venues, to how every family hears about a change. You will work with the PM, engineering, support and customer success to decide what we build, how it should work and feel, and how we know it worked.

What You'll Do:

  • Design the scheduling experience end to end. Shape how teams, leagues and organizations create, edit and share schedules.

  • Make scheduling seamless across every experience. Work with the PM to decide how scheduling shows up in TeamSnap ONE, and keep it coherent across web, iOS and Android.

  • Go deep on the domain. Design for the full scheduling lifecycle: creating and importing schedules, RSVP and availability, conflict detection, venue and facility constraints, recurring events, calendar sync, and change notifications.

  • Design for the people who actually run sports. Create flows for volunteer coaches, parents and league administrators who are busy, often on a phone, and managing schedules in the margins of their day.

  • Learn directly from customers. Build prototypes to test ideas early, run interviews and usability tests in partnership with the PM, iterate based on feedback and data.

  • Apply AI. Design how people interact with AI-assisted scheduling, such as schedule generation, conflict resolution and faster edits. Use AI in your own research, ideation and prototyping.

  • Bring clarity to complex flows. Turn messy customer problems into flows, wireframes and high-fidelity designs with edge cases covered.

  • Ship with engineering. Partner with engineers from early concepts through QA, and make sure what ships matches what was designed.

  • Strengthen the system. Contribute components and patterns to the TeamSnap design system so scheduling work stays consistent and quick to build.

  • Measure what matters. Help define success metrics for what you design, review adoption and outcomes with the PM, and iterate on what you learn.

    • What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 3+ years of product design experience in software or SaaS, with a portfolio showing B2B or B2B2C products you launched and iterated on.

  • Strong craft across interaction design, information architecture and UI design, with a portfolio that shows your process from problem framing to shipped work.

  • Proficiency with Figma and comfort working with a design system.

  • Fluency with AI in design work: using AI to speed up ideation and prototyping.

  • Experience running user research, from interviews to usability tests, and turning findings into clear design decisions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present your thinking and explain trade-offs.

  • A customer-centric mindset, comfort with ambiguity, and attention to detail on workflows where small mistakes have real consequences.

  • A collaborative working style with product managers and engineers, and experience using tools like Jira to stay in sync.

    • Bonus points:

  • Hands-on experience designing scheduling, calendar or comparable time-and-resource-allocation products.

  • Experience designing B2B tools.

  • Experience with mobile-first products.

  • Experience designing accessible, inclusive interfaces, including WCAG standards.

  • Familiarity with youth sports, as a coach, parent, league or volunteer.

    • Compensation: 

    We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $120,000, inclusive of base and commission, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.


    🖥 Location

    TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you'll need to be comfortable working with people in other time zones.

    We're always expanding, but we can't currently hire in Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, or Utah. We can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

    🚀 Opportunities to Grow

    We work hard on a culture built on trust, accountability, and inclusion — one where you can take on more, make a lasting impact, and have some fun doing it.

    🎩 Total Rewards
    • Remote-first since 2009
    • Flexible PTO and parental leave
    • 100% premium coverage of medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
    • 401(k) to invest in your future
    • $1,500 annual learning and development reimbursement
    • Travel to all-company meetings and team events
    • Generous home office allowance
    • TeamSnap swag when you start, plus a $50 store credit on every work anniversary
    • Monthly health and wellness reimbursement, and more
    • TeamSnap Total Rewards
    🏆  Award-winning Culture

    At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit – you're a culture add. Read our Culture Playbook to see how we play, what we ask of each other, and what drives us.

    🧡 Inclusion and Diversity

    Creativity and innovation don't come from cookie-cutter teams. We hold ourselves accountable for building a culture where everyone is valued.

    Need any accommodations during the interview process? Just ask. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

    AI Notice

    We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and resumes or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team; they don't replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people. Contact us if you'd like more information about how your data is processed.
